pages.title: Ripe for Picking
pages.text: Break one fully grown tomato or lettuce crop.

pages.title: Ripe for Picking
pages.text: Harvest a mature plant instead of buying its produce.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Wait until the crop is mature. Replant afterwards; right-click harvesting is convenient for later crops.

pages.title: Raise kitchen crops
pages.text: Wild barley, oats, corn, tomatoes, lettuce, onions and strawberries provide different kitchen ingredients. Grow what your recipes need instead of collecting every crop name.

pages.title: Obtain cooking crops
pages.text: A Straw Hat helps find cooking seeds when working grass; a Sickle helps harvest. Check lettuce for caterpillars; the Scarecrow also accepts decorative equipment.

pages.title: Separate traits grant small experience from genuine mature harves
pages.text: Separate traits grant small experience from genuine mature harvests and real catches after their thresholds and cooldowns. Empty actions do not yield endless experience.
